svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Order desk subtitle: From order to delivered and paid; three steps use the team's own icons kind: flowchart look: card layout: { spacing: compact } # The team's own drawings, made to the rules in references/icons.md and passed by `orrery icons check`. icons: order-desk: ./icons/order-desk.svg credit-check: ./icons/credit-check.svg pick-pack: ./icons/pick-pack.svg nodes: # The entry and the three exits are terminators that carry their icons. customer: { shape: terminator, icon: generic:customer, label: Customer orders } desk: { icon: local:order-desk, label: Order desk, note: "Phone, mail or web" } credit: { icon: local:credit-check, label: Credit check } limit: { shape: decision, label: Within limit? } # The no branch leaves the decision sideways, as flowcharts draw it; yes carries straight on. manager: { icon: generic:manager, label: Sales manager, align: limit } declined: { shape: terminator, icon: generic:failure, label: Order declined } pick: { icon: local:pick-pack, label: Pick and pack, note: Warehouse bench } courier: { icon: generic:delivery, label: Courier } delivered: { shape: terminator, icon: generic:success, label: Delivered } invoice: { icon: generic:invoice, label: Invoice, note: Net 30 } paid: { shape: terminator, icon: generic:cash, label: Paid } edges: - customer -> desk - desk -> credit -> limit - limit -> pick: yes - limit -> manager: no - manager -> pick: signs off - manager -> declined: declines # The warehouse and accounts work in parallel once the order is approved. - pick -> courier -> delivered - pick -> invoice -> paid

svg.title: Order desk
svg.desc: Order desk. 11 components. Connections: Customer orders to Order desk; Order desk to Credit check; Credit check to Within limit?; Within limit? to Pick and pack (yes); Within limit? to Sales manager (no); Sales manager to Pick and pack (signs off); Sales manager to Order declined (declines); Pick and pack to Courier; Courier to Delivered; Pick and pack to Invoice; Invoice to Paid.

text.tspan: From order to delivered and paid; three steps use the team's own icons
